title: Rank-quality calibration playbook and stability scan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create an operational playbook and automated stability-scan for reranker quantization profiles (FP8/INT8) that ties calibration steps to ranking-quality gates (NDCG@10, MRR). The goal is to (1) make calibration reproducible across model variants and sequence-length distributions, (2) identify brittle layers and ops that cause ranking regressions, and (3) produce a clear decision matrix for when to accept a quant profile vs. require fallback or per-layer mixed precision.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Reproduceable calibration workflow with seedable RNG and fixed data splits. 2) Automated NDCG@10 and MRR sweep across candidate profiles with clear pass/fail thresholds. 3) Failure modes documented and mapped to remediation steps (per-layer dequant, fallback to FP16, retrain calibration set). 4) CI job artifacts (plots, calibration logs, PR checklist) generated and linked in the PR.
calibration_workflow: 1) Collect calibration corpus: stratify by length, domain, and top-K difficulty; freeze RNG seed
2) Export FP16 model activations on calibration corpus using deterministic batching (batch_size=8/16 depending on memory)
3) Sweep quant parameters: per-channel vs per-tensor, clipping percentile (99.9/99.5/99.0), symmetric vs asymmetric, scale-type (max/median/percentile), and int8 zero-point handling
4) For FP8 experiments include exponent bias handling and dynamic range clamping heuristics; test both E4M3 and E3M5 layouts
5) Run post-calibration validation: run reranker end-to-end on holdout set to compute NDCG/MRR and per-layer activation KL divergence
6) If regression > threshold (see gates), run binary ablation: disable quant on one layer at a time (top-5 by activation L2) to localize sensitivity
7) Produce profile artifact: profile name, hash, quant settings, per-layer exceptions, calibration seed, and artifact URL
8) Publish results to dashboard and attach to release PR along with recommended rollout policy (canary % and fallback profile)
9) Archive raw calibration logs and per-example rank diffs for auditability
evaluation_gates: Safety gate: < 2% of queries may experience Top1 change for high-traffic customer segments
Stability gate: per-query rank-shift 95th percentile <= 3 positions
scan_parameters: batching: simulate production batch distribution (p50=1, p90=4, p99=16)
stress-conditions: cache-warm vs cold, kv-cache evictions, truncated prompts
results_summary: Initial sweep (E4M3 + int8-per-channel with 99.5 percentile clipping) yielded mean delta NDCG@10 = -0.0011 and delta MRR@10 = -0.0009 on holdout; passed primary and secondary gates but failing stability gate in long-tail queries. Ablation localized sensitivity to attention output projection in layer 18 and to the final FFN gating in layer 23. Per-layer exception on those two layers (force FP16) recovers full parity (delta NDCG@10 = -0.00015). Recommended default profile: FP8-E4M3 global + int8-per-channel fallback for selected matmuls with per-layer FP16 exceptions. Can deploy as runtime-1.20 candidate with a 10% canary and NDCG/MRR monitoring with automated rollback at gate breach.
blockers: Need signed-off CI quota for running full sweep across seeds and sequence-lengths (billing approval)
Instrumentation gaps: current eval harness does not capture per-example KV-cache state which is needed to reproduce some edge regressions
next_steps: Add per-example KV-cache flag to eval harness (owner: infra-eng)
Create PR that implements per-layer exception metadata in model-serving config and runtime to honor fallbacks
Schedule canary for runtime-1.20 with 10% traffic and 72h observation window
Prepare customer communication about potential small ranking shifts and rollback plan
